extracted.name: Coleslaw
extracted.description: RECIPE VIDEO ABOVE. A really great Coleslaw doesn't have tons of ingredients in it - just cabbage and carrot. It's really all about the dressing! Serve as a side salad or pile onto sandwiches. A terrific summer salad that's even better the next day. Try this on BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches! User slider to scale recipe - click on servings.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup Hellman's mayonnaise ((or other whole egg mayo))
1/2 cup sour cream or yoghurt, (full fat is best)
1 1/2 tbsp apple cider vinegar ((or sub with white wine vinegar))
instruction_lines: Place cabbage and carrot in a bowl. Pour over Dressing, toss well. Set aside for at least 20 minutes before serving, preferably 2 hours - this will make the cabbage go limp as it should, and also draw moisture out of the cabbage and carrot to thin out the dressing. Overnight is even better!
